name: Wren
backstory: Wren flies letters between hollow trees and considers every doorstep a possible home.

specialRequest.text: Just got back from the longest route I've ever flown. Give me something that feels like landing.

requests.text: Something that feels like coming home. Nothing too sad.
I want a story about people who end up as family, even if they didn't start that way.
I've got three days off and I want to go somewhere without actually going anywhere.
Nothing with a battlefield in it, please. I've delivered too many casualty letters this month.

name: Old Thistle
backstory: Thistle hexed her last landlord and retired the same week, on principle.

specialRequest.text: I've read everything twice. Surprise this old woman, if you can manage it.

requests.text: Give me a book with some weight to it.
Something that happened a long time ago, told properly.
I want to be kept guessing until the last page.
No moping about sweethearts. I want a whole book, not half a romance.

name: Pip
backstory: Pip is apprenticed to three different masters at once and hasn't told any of them.

specialRequest.text: I snuck out between lessons. Quick, before someone notices, give me your best short one.

requests.text: I need something fun for the train. Short, please!
Got any books about learning magic the hard way?
I want to laugh. I have had a week.
Something with a proper quest in it. Not a long one, my attention span is famously bad.

name: Lady Veil
backstory: Lady Veil has haunted the reading nook since long before it had a name, and misses her correspondence more than her life.

specialRequest.text: It has been a hundred and thirty years since anyone courted me properly. Find me a book that remembers how.

requests.text: Something with candlelight and longing.
I want a house with a past. The gloomier the better.
No spaceships. I do not trust the future.
Nothing that plays love for laughs. I take it seriously.

name: Bramble
backstory: Bramble has stood in the same clearing for four hundred years and resents anyone who moved faster than a tree.

specialRequest.text: You've earned the right to stop wasting my time with easy books. Give me something with real teeth.

requests.text: No fluff. I want teeth.
Give me two people who should hate each other.
Something about my own kind, for once, and not the cheerful sort.
I have no patience for low stakes. Make it matter.

name: The Twins
description: Two pixies who share one book
backstory: The Twins have never finished a sentence separately and see no reason to start.

specialRequest.text: We agreed on something for once. Don't waste it.

requests.text: We only have one afternoon. Make it count.
We want to laugh at the same parts. Every time.
Nothing heavy. We share everything, including bad moods, and we'd rather not.
No big important books. We just want a nice time.

name: Mirelle
backstory: Mirelle surfaces from the lake once a week, always with a new theory and always missing dinner.

specialRequest.text: I have a whole week free of surfacing duties. Give me the book you'd be embarrassed to admit you loved.

requests.text: Something that makes me think for days.
I want a puzzle with a real solution, not a feeling.
One book, whole and complete. I don't want to wait for sequels.
No romance subplot, please. I'm here for the ideas.

name: The Collector
description: Gloved, and never gives a name
backstory: The Collector has outbid three museums this year and will not say what for.

specialRequest.text: I am told you can be discreet. I want the one nobody else will sell me.

requests.text: Something from the locked case. I'll know if you fetch me an ordinary book.
I collect the difficult ones. What have you that nobody finishes?
A provenance, please, not a paperback.
I want a puzzle that has outlived its author.
